name: Georgia
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Georgia's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): the Chattahoochee in the west, the Florida line in the south, the Tennessee/North Carolina line in the north, and Tybee Island in the east. The east edge stops at the barrier islands, so open Atlantic is trimmed. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-ga.
